description.en: A fossil lotus leaf forms a round peltate blade with veins radiating from the petiole insertion.
description.zh: 化石莲叶为圆形盾状叶，叶脉由叶柄着生点放射。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Nelumbo, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Nelumbo 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: A complete peltate disc differs from notched water-lily leaves and the compound floating rosettes.
distinctness.zh: 完整盾状圆盘区别于缺口睡莲叶及复叶浮生莲座。

modeling_brief.en: Make a shallow circular folded relief with a central attachment mark and broad radial sectors; no guessed flower or seed pod.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作带中央着生痕和宽放射区的浅折面圆盘浮雕，不添加猜测花或莲蓬。

uncertainty: Leaf specimen only; no modern species identity or complete plant is asserted.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Fossil Plants of Fossil Butte
sources.supports: Eocene Lygodium, Salvinia and Nelumbo fossil context.
